race.comment: OPAWA ARCHIE (1) last raced on July 30 when fifth (17.11) over 295m at Addington in a R/A FIN. Drawn the rails and rates a key runner. PAW ZANY (3) has a fair record and proved too strong last time to win by 2 lengths at this track in a handy 19.84 beating Paw Yuri. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. Leading player again. SARSAPARILLA KID (2) recorded two placings in a row before an overdue win last time, scoring by 0.9 lengths (20.17) at this track. Makes plenty of appeal if runs up to latest. TOP KADE (8) boasts a solid strike-rate over this track and distance.
